tasks.label: Build KIM tape
tasks.command: mkdir -p build && ca65 --cpu 6502 -l "build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.lst" -o "build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.o" "${relativeFile}" && ld65 -C kim.cfg -o "build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.bin" "build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.o" && srec_cat "build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.bin" -binary -offset 0x0200 "build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.bin-low.bin" -binary -offset 0x0100 -o "build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.tape" -MOS_Technologies
